declarations.description:
The "Display" popover of a collection: which layout it uses, what it is grouped and sub-grouped by, how it is
ordered (several levels), which kinds of items it includes and which properties each item shows. The component
holds no data and renders no items; it edits one `ViewOptionsValue` and fires `view-change`, and the app applies the
value to whatever draws the collection. `orderBy` has the shape of `c2-table`'s `sortModel`, `groupBy` feeds its
`group-by` and `properties` its columns' `hidden`.

Fields come from `c2-view-field` children or from the `fields` array, which wins when both are present and shares
`id`, `label` and `icon` with `c2-filter-builder`'s fields. The Show switches come from `c2-view-toggle` children or
the `toggles` array the same way. A section with nothing to offer is left out.

The component stores nothing: keep `value` wherever the app keeps settings. With `default-value` set, Reset returns
to it and the host matches `:state(changed)` while the value differs (the default trigger shows a dot). On a `board`
layout, Grouping and Sub-grouping read Columns and Rows.

The trigger is slotted into `trigger`; without one a "Display" button is drawn. The panel is a non-modal dialog on
the top layer, positioned by `c2-overlay`: Escape and a click outside close it and focus returns to the trigger.

slots.description: `c2-view-field` and `c2-view-toggle` elements. They render nothing themselves.

The element that opens the panel. Without one, a "Display" button is drawn. A `c2-*` trigger gets `aria-haspopup` and `aria-expanded` on its inner button; a plain element is the author's markup, so write `aria-haspopup="dialog"` on it yourself (`aria-expanded` is kept up to date once the panel has opened).
slots.name: trigger

slots.description: App-specific rows (density, timeline zoom) shown below the Show switches.
slots.name: extra

members.name: value
members.description: The view being edited. JSON as an attribute. Missing keys fall back to the first layout, no grouping, no ordering, each toggle's `checked` and every property field.

members.name: defaultValue
members.description: What Reset returns to, and what the value is compared with for `:state(changed)`. JSON as an attribute. Without it there is no Reset.

members.name: fields
members.description: Fields to offer. JSON as an attribute. Replaces the `c2-view-field` children when set.

members.name: toggles
members.description: Switches of the Show section. JSON as an attribute. Replaces the `c2-view-toggle` children when set.

members.name: layouts
members.description: Layout ids, space-separated: `list board table gallery calendar timeline` have an icon and a label; any other id is shown as written. One id (or none) hides the Layout switch.

members.name: maxSorts
members.description: How many ordering levels "Add sort" allows. `1` gives a single sort.

members.name: canSetDefault
members.description: Show "Set as default", which fires `default-request`.

members.name: open
members.description: Whether the panel is showing. Set it to open or close the panel from code.

members.name: placement
members.description: Preferred placement of the panel next to the trigger (floating-ui names).

members.name: hasSlottedTrigger
members.description:
Whether the app slotted its own trigger. The Display button is then left out of the shadow root rather than kept as
the slot's fallback, which WebKit still exposes to assistive technology next to the slotted trigger.

members.name: serverRendered
members.description: A declarative shadow root at construction: the first client render must match the server's, which saw no children.

members.name: openBeforePress
members.description: Open state at the pointerdown that started a press on the trigger; the popover light-dismisses before the click.

members.name: resolvedFields
members.description: The fields in use: `fields` when set, otherwise the `c2-view-field` children.

members.name: resolvedToggles
members.description: The switches in use: `toggles` when set, otherwise the `c2-view-toggle` children.

members.name: view
members.description: The current value with every missing key filled in: what the panel shows and what `view-change` carries.

members.name: changed
members.description: Whether the value differs from `default-value`. Always false without one.

members.name: commit
members.description: Applies one edit, keeps the value consistent and announces it.

members.name: definitions
members.description:
The direct children, unwrapped: in the docs app every element of an example is an Astro island, so a
`c2-view-field` arrives as the first element of its wrapper.

members.name: scheduleReadChildren
members.description: Children report each of their updates; read them once per task however many reported.

members.name: syncTriggerAria
members.description:
A plain light-DOM trigger is the author's markup, which a server rendered: it is only written once the user has
opened the panel, long after any framework hydrated it. `userOpened` says that has happened.

members.name: stopInnerEvent
members.description: The inner controls fire composed `change`/`input`; they are this component's plumbing, not its events.

events.name: view-change
events.description: Fired after the user edits the value. `detail.value` is the whole new value (already in `value`), `detail.changed` the key that changed, or `null` after Reset. Does not bubble.
Fired by "Set as default" with the current value. The app decides who may save it, then sets `default-value`. Does not bubble.
events.name: default-request

events.description: Fired after the panel opens or closes; `newState` is `open` or `closed`.
events.name: toggle

declarations.description: Private protocol event: a `c2-view-field` or `c2-view-toggle` changed, so its `c2-view-options` re-reads its children.

One field of a `c2-view-options`, written in markup. Renders nothing: the parent reads it. A `fields` array set on
the parent replaces every `c2-view-field` child.
